Product Details: The XTRA POWER High Torque Bits with Magnetic Ring are precision-engineered fastener drive bits designed for professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike. Each bit measures 65MM in length and features a PH2 (Phillips Head 2) tip, making it compatible with a wide range of screws commonly used in woodworking, construction, and general assembly tasks. The magnetic ring ensures that screws stay firmly in place during driving, reducing the risk of dropping or misaligning fasteners — especially useful when working in tight or hard-to-reach spaces. Built to deliver high torque performance, these bits are crafted from hardened steel to withstand demanding applications without stripping or wearing down quickly. The extended 65MM length provides better reach and improved control, allowing for efficient and accurate screw driving. This pack includes 10 bits, making it ideal for extended use on the job site or workshop. Compatible with most standard power drills and screwdrivers, these bits are a reliable addition to any toolkit. Whether you are a seasoned tradesperson or a weekend DIYer, XTRA POWER bits offer consistent performance and durability for everyday fastening needs.
